content.title: Triangular Dance Synchronization | Delay, Formation Travel, Shared Final Beat
content.summary: Establish one lead and a rear pair, use a one-beat delay before synchronization, preserve the moving triangle and close on one shared gesture.

quick_start.input_format: A lead and rear pair establish one stable triangle. + Rear performers echo one beat after the lead before synchronization. + Forward travel preserves spacing and screen order. + The camera uses one slow push rather than competing movement. + All performers finish one identical gesture on the same beat.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place three adult museum technicians in a shallow triangle inside an empty loading gallery, with the lead nearest camera. All three advance together along one floor seam while preserving their triangular spacing. Return to the compact triangle and lock one final hand-and-shoulder pose as the camera completes a slow push.
